summary: Inspected all 4 changed Chebotarev Lean files. Each file contains substantial formal mathematical content (definitions, theorems, proofs) for the Chebotarev density theorem: Density.lean defines Dirichlet density and its asymptotic properties; NormLeOneLipschitz.lean provides the Lipschitz frontier cover for effective lattice-point counting; NumberFieldEulerProduct.lean establishes the generic Euler product infrastructure; ZetaProduct.lean contains the zeta factorization, analytic extension, and non-vanishing proof for abelian L-functions. summary: Inspected projects/Chebotarev/CebotarevDensity/Main.lean (28227 bytes). This file contains the main statement and proof of Chebotarev's density theorem (chebotarev_density), the abelian case (chebotarev_density_of_comm), the density of completely split primes (density_split_completely), and Dirichlet's theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions (dirichlet_primes_in_AP) as a corollary. It also includes numerous supporting lemmas (ConjClasses_carrier_card_eq_one_of_comm, infinite_of_hasDirichletDensity_pos, ConjClasses_carrier_card_pos, infinite_setOf_frobenius_class, ConjClasses_mk_one_carrier_card_eq_one) and private implementation lemmas for the Dirichlet AP proof (frobeniusClass_eq_iff_residue, residue_iff_half, dirichlet_AP_fibre_diff_image_subset_bad, dirichlet_AP_image_diff_fibre_subset_bad, dirichlet_AP_main, dirichlet_AP_two_mul). The file is not a pure import aggregator — it declares and proves core mathematical theorems. No content-level reason exists to exclude it from the primary mathematical-content index.
